videos.headline: Chattanooga wins NIT after UC Irvine's heartbreaking miss at the buzzer
videos.description: UC Irvine has a great look at a game-winning basket, but the shot rims out and Chattanooga comes away with the win.

tracking.trackingName: NCB_One-Play (Chattanooga wins NIT after UC Irvine's heartbreaking miss at the buzzer) 2025/04/04 ESHEET
